notes.title: Beta Test Now Live – Download the Demo!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The Beta Test for Card Cultivation is now live! The latest demo version has been updated on our Steam store page, and we warmly invite all players to download and try it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963600/

Please note that the current demo is only available in Simplified Chinese. We are working hard to prepare an English version—thank you for your patience!

[b]What’s New in This Test:[/b]

This second round brings a wealth of new content for you to explore. Players can now unlock most of the core gameplay elements from the Foundation Stage.
Once your character successfully breaks through from the Qi Refining Stage to the Foundation Stage, the **Sword Flight** feature will be unlocked, allowing you to soar and explore a much broader world of cultivation.


[b]Note:[/b]
If the game fails to start after downloading, try clearing the save files manually:
Save file path: `%APPDATA%\..\LocalLow\DarkIndex\CardCultivation`

If the issue persists or you encounter any serious bugs, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/vN93KSFa]Discord channel[/url] to report them.

notes.title: Card Cultivation Joins Eastern Game Fest 2025
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that Card Cultivation is officially featured in [b]Eastern Game Fest 2025[/b] on Steam!

This ink-wash-style deckbuilding adventure invites you to step into the shoes of an amnesiac cultivator. As you fend off mythical beasts, explore ancient realms, forge magical artifacts, and master powerful techniques, your forgotten past slowly returns — leading you toward ascending.

The demo is now available for you to dive in, featuring over 500 unique cards and playable stages across the Qi Refining, Foundation Building realms.

Whether you're here for the strategic deckbuilding or the serene Eastern aesthetic, we welcome you to join our cultivation journey. Your feedback is incredibly valuable as we continue to polish and expand the world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963600/_/

Let the path to immortality begin.

notes.title: Card Cultivation has released its latest demo!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

Card Cultivation has released the latest demo on Steam, feel free to download it and try!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963600/_/

Last October, Card Cultivation completed its first internal playtest, followed by a public test that wrapped up this February. During this time, we invited many fans of card games and cultivation themes to try out the game and share their feedback. Since then, we've been working hard to improve the game — and now, we’re thrilled to present a new demo for everyone to enjoy!

Compared to previous test versions, the new demo features major improvements to the new tutorial, including dedicated a sense to help new players easily get started. We’ve also added a currency system, allowing players to trade extra resources for Stones and purchase other valuable items. This system will continue to expand and unlock more gameplay possibilities in the future — stay tuned!

For more detailed changes, feel free to check out our latest announcement. But of course, the best way to experience it is to explore by yourself!

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2963600/view/536597286667419703

Please join our [url=https://discord.gg/WKMUYm8q9X]Discord channel[/url] if you have feedback about the game. If you enjoy Card Cultivation, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: English Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are delighted that some English-speaking players have recently shown interest in Card Cultivation. We have added an English option to introduce more players from different language backgrounds to enjoy the game. You can switch to English in the [b]Language[/b] settings to experience the game.

[h3]Please note that the current English version is a preliminary translation, and the text may not yet be fully adapted to the game content. This could result in a less smooth gameplay experience.[/h3]

We plan to optimize the translation after the Spring Festival to provide a more seamless and high-quality multilingual experience. Thank you for your understanding and support!

Please join our [url=https://discord.gg/WKMUYm8q9X]Discord channel[/url] if you have feedback about the game. If you enjoy Card Cultivation, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!

如果您想参与这次测试，请填写这份招募问卷：[url=https://wj.qq.com/s2/15365940/buz9/]https://wj.qq.com/s2/15365940/buz9/[/url]

我们将以招募问卷的填写结果作为筛选标准，请各位认真作答，期待你们能成为首次测试的玩家并提出宝贵的意见！！



《卡牌修仙传》是由我们开发的以卡牌为主要形式的修仙题材模拟器游戏，玩法灵感来源于《堆叠大陆》与《密教模拟器》，为您带来水墨风格的全新“修仙”体验。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221155/c6bc75e173cbb91d3d5596c0da90cbdb379046a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221155/65676175736fe408fcca3429c1f402589e8e6746.png[/img]
《卡牌修仙传》的故事从一位失忆的侠士在风水宝地醒来开始，一边修炼飞升一边寻找自己身世的秘密。
在这个以《山海经》为底蕴设计的世界里，修炼心法、炼制丹药、收集法宝、拜入宗门、探索妖穴等，你都能以卡牌的形式体验到。超一千张卡牌、五十多个秘境，带你体验这个独特的修仙世界。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221155/810a2cd6fff897b9ed0e1db2778976d00f2706c3.gif[/img]

点击链接查看我们最新发布的游戏玩法视频：[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1HHxKeVEF4/]https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1HHxKeVEF4/[/url]

游戏特点：

[list]
[*] 有趣的卡牌化修仙玩法：游戏中的所有内容均以卡牌方式展示，通过卡牌和卡牌、卡牌与工作台之间的交互型衍生出多样的交互结果。

[*] 自由的桌上大世界：以山海经为底蕴设计的架空修仙世界，自由御剑飞行，遭遇各种随机事件，打造绝世武器培养灵宠炼制丹药。

[*] 丰富的卡牌内容：超过1000+张卡牌，20+工作台，50+秘境。包含人物，法宝，心法，材料，草药，妖兽，宗门等诸多修仙世界的内容。
[/list]

如果您对《卡牌修仙传》感兴趣，请将它加入您的愿望单，这对我们是莫大的支持与鼓励！
